capabilities: chat with AI models in a chat view inside the main window
add notes and tags as request context with a token estimate
switch between models and system prompts per message
save chats as markdown notes that stay editable and continueable
run web searches and collect sources for supported models
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Chat notes depend on specific frontmatter fields and HTML comment markers that must not be edited if chats are to continue.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, so talking to AI models while using notes and tags as context requires leaving the app or copying content back and forth.

relations.evidence: The Excalidraw plugin was also an important source of inspiration and design patterns for implementing the custom chat view.

requires.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Perplexity API key
paid provider account (Anthropic and Perplexity require it; some Google models have limited free tiers)

summary: AI chat plugin that runs conversations with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Perplexity models and saves chats as vault markdown notes.
